name: Basket Close 2
summary: Basket Close 2 is a utility EA that monitors the net profit/loss of all open positions (the 'basket') and automatically closes all trades when a user-defined profit target or loss limit is reached. It serves as a portfolio-level risk management tool rather than a signal-based trading system.
summary_zh: Basket Close 2是一个工具型EA，用于监控所有持仓的净盈亏（即'篮子'），当达到用户设定的盈利目标或亏损限额时自动平仓所有订单。它是一个组合级别的风险管理工具，而非基于信号的交易系统。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于篮子盈亏的整体仓位管理，而非基于技术指标的开仓策略。入场条件不适用，因为此EA不自行开仓，仅监控已有持仓。出场条件为：当所有持仓的净浮动利润达到设定的盈利目标时全部平仓，或当净浮动亏损达到设定的止损限额时全部平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已存在仓位的批量关闭。资金管理通过设定篮子级别的盈亏阈值来控制整体账户风险敞口，防止单方向过度浮亏或锁定整体盈利。该工具适合同时运行多个策略或多个订单的交易者，帮助其实现账户级别的盈亏控制，避免情绪化手动平仓决策。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is basket-level position management based on aggregate profit/loss, rather than an indicator-driven entry strategy. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open trades on its own; it only monitors existing positions. Exit conditions are triggered when the net floating profit of all open positions reaches a user-defined profit target (closing all for profit) or when the net floating loss hits a user-defined loss limit (closing all to stop further loss). Position sizing is not handled by this EA as it does not calculate lot sizes for new orders; it only manages the batch closure of existing positions. Money management is implemented through basket-level profit/loss thresholds that control overall account risk exposure, preventing excessive drawdown in one direction or locking in aggregate profits. This tool is well-suited for traders running multiple strategies or orders simultaneously, helping them implement account-level profit/loss control and avoid emotionally driven manual closure decisions.

parameters.name: ProfitTarget
parameters.description: 篮子盈利目标，达到后全部平仓
parameters.description_en: Basket profit target, close all when reached

parameters.name: LossLimit
parameters.description: 篮子亏损限额，达到后全部平仓
parameters.description_en: Basket loss limit, close all when reached

parameters.name: CloseAllOnTarget
parameters.description: 是否在达到目标时关闭所有订单
parameters.description_en: Close all orders when target is reached

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定魔术号过滤订单，0为所有订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number to filter orders, 0 for all

parameters.name: ScanInterval
parameters.description: 扫描间隔时间，控制检查频率

pros: 提供账户级别的整体盈亏管理，避免情绪化交易决策
支持同时关闭所有持仓，有效控制尾部风险和极端行情下的损失
作为工具型EA可与任何交易策略组合使用，兼容性强
锁定整体盈利的机制有助于培养纪律性交易习惯
pros_en: Provides account-level aggregate profit/loss management, eliminating emotional trading decisions
Supports simultaneous closure of all positions, effectively controlling tail risk and losses during extreme market conditions
As a utility EA, it can be combined with any trading strategy, offering strong compatibility
The profit-locking mechanism helps cultivate disciplined trading habits
cons: 不区分不同策略的持仓，可能关闭盈利策略的订单来止损另一个策略
在网络延迟或市场剧烈波动时，批量平仓可能无法全部成功执行
缺乏分批平仓或部分平仓功能，灵活性不足
如果未设置合理的止损限额，可能在高波动市场中造成较大滑点损失
cons_en: Does not differentiate between positions from different strategies, potentially closing profitable strategy orders to cut losses from another strategy
During network latency or extreme market volatility, batch closure may not execute all orders successfully
Lacks partial or staggered closure functionality, limiting flexibility in profit-taking
Without a reasonable loss limit configured, slippage during high volatility markets could result in significant losses
improvements: 增加按策略魔术号分组管理功能，允许对不同策略设置不同的篮子盈亏阈值
增加分批平仓功能，支持按比例逐步平仓以减少滑点影响
增加移动止损功能，当篮子盈利达到一定比例后自动上移止损线以保护利润
improvements_en: Add per-strategy magic number grouping, allowing different basket profit/loss thresholds for different strategies
Add partial/staged closure functionality, supporting proportional gradual closing to reduce slippage impact
Add a trailing stop feature for the basket, automatically raising the stop-loss line after reaching a certain profit ratio to protect gains

risk_points: 批量平仓在极端行情下可能因滑点导致实际亏损超过设定的止损限额
如果与多个策略同时运行，关闭所有订单可能干扰其他策略的正常运作
risk_points_en: Batch closure during extreme market conditions may result in actual losses exceeding the configured loss limit due to slippage
When running alongside multiple strategies, closing all orders may disrupt the normal operation of other strategies

summary_en: Basket Close 2 is a utility EA that monitors the net profit/loss of all open positions (the 'basket') and automatically closes all trades when a user-defined profit target or loss limit is reached. It serves as a portfolio-level risk management tool rather than a signal-based trading system.
